claims.statement: Planning guide declares FPT/GHEC/GHES and describes product/project/team/personal repository models. Team code can span repositories and separate issue/code repositories enable different permissions; examples do not require monorepo or unrelated repository restructuring.
Create-repository first-step wording is tutorial workflow, not universal mandate to create a new repository for every feature; existing function-owned models and approved ownership remain preserved.

README introduction/onboarding/contact and CONTRIBUTING interaction guidelines are optional recommendations; example Project Octocat identity/contact must be parameterized, not copied into deployment.

Release/initiative/feature/bug issue use cases and selected templates/forms depend on team needs. Unqualified forms prose must retain detailed FPT/GHEC feature restriction; template presence not validated intake or accepted policy.

Sub-issue hierarchy and organization types classify/decompose work; text tasklist cloud additional functionality counts tasks and auto-checks linked closed issues. Lifecycle checkbox completion is not independently verified acceptance.
Front-end and bug labels and example metadata are illustrative values, not mandated profile parameters or audited work categories.
Dependency section links Free-Pro-Team latest; detailed cloud-only dependency availability and display-versus-enforcement limits qualify generic coordination claims.

Copilot conditional cloud feature requires subscription context and supports summaries/history/technical explanation/next-step suggestions. Generated interpretation does not establish prior decisions, scope completeness, code truth or authorized implementation.

Issues support focused details/status updates while Discussions serve open-ended cross-repository brainstorming. Communication/status reporting is not acknowledgment, execution receipt or fresh acceptance evidence.

Label paragraph unconditionally includes discussions while detailed label guide conditions discussion labeling to FPT/GHEC. Keep GHES discussion-label capability unresolved rather than extending parent wildcard scope.

Projects automatic information sync and layout examples remain qualified by actual permissions, fields, filters, archive omissions and freshness. Todo/In-progress/Done presentation cannot certify enforced work lifecycle or accepted results.
Next-step links enumerate related source scope without reviewing linked files or published page versions. No new repository, AI request, native feature or estate rollout performed.
